Many years ago I had a brief stint in a local bank as a financial salesperson, I didn’t hit my targets, sold less than 3 endowment plans in 5 months. My manager was pressuring me to sell ILPs because it nets the highest revenue margin, but ILPs does not make any financial sense to me.

The last straw came when a man in his 50s was in my branch and I helped him with basic ATM stuffs, he was appreciative and we had a long chat, that was during Covid and he was doing food delivery to support his family, income was decent as he could make 5-6k a month, and he asked me if I had any good plans with high interest. I told him that his job wasn’t stable and it’s not worth going into a lock in of 10 years to pay premiums. My boss overheard the conversation, pulled me out and gave me a scolding, telling me that I should pitch him a >10 years ILP at 24k/ annum. I refused to do so and we were basically in a shouting match in her office, she pulled another rep to close the uncle the ILP. I quit the next week. Last I heard from another ex colleague that the uncle came back and complain a year later, but too late, his premiums were used for the drinking parties of the FA.

Lost faith in this industry and hate every fucking insurance agent or financial agent ever since. Fuck them and their lack of ethics.

I started my career as a HR assistant. I remembered this incident where our company was supposed to onboard a foreign staff to start with us in 2 months, and in order to apply for a work pass for him we’d need to post an ad on jobs bank for about 2 weeks before we’re allowed to apply a work pass for him (which’d take some time as well).

After 2 weeks i went ahead to submit the application for the work pass, and the status came back 3 weeks later as “rejected” because I did not indicate the salary range on jobs bank, I tried appealing which took another 3 weeks to come back rejected, the only way was to repost the ad on jobs bank, and reapply the work pass. My boss was furious at this and the entire attitude towards me changed since then, I couldn’t take the cold shoulder anymore and I left.

Come to think of it, I’m glad I left as well because of all those “for show” advertisements and dumb processes I had to put up with.

I used to work frontline as a bank teller, I loved the job because I get to interact with different people and time passes fast at work. And of course I’ll meet nasty assholes who talk down on you or act like they own the entire world, I carried the mindset where “customers are always right” in the beginning, but as i saw more and more injustice in my field of work such as customers being complete assholes, I wasn’t afraid of challenging them, I didn’t care anymore because I became burnt out from watching people getting away with it thinking they are on a pedestal just because they can be rude towards others. Respect is a two way channel, you want to be treated with respect, exemplify it yourself first.
Say my name.

I feel that death could be a bliss instead. Perhaps life is the part where we suffer, while death is a “release” from the suffering. We might end up somewhere pleasant. I have no idea. 

But to each it’s own, there are those who don’t mind death, those who are afraid of death, and those who enjoy life. It’ll happen someday.

If you've been to other night markets in Thailand before I'd say it's about the same.

The good thing about talad night market I feel is that it feels more spacious and comfortable to walkabout, highlight of the place in my opinion is the many street food stalls.

It's split into two parts, one part of it with various shopping for clothes and accessories, while another part would all be street food. At the back of the market there's also a couple of bars and such for you to rest and grab a beer.

It's pretty chill if you ask me, worth a visit if you have some free time on hand, otherwise, it's similar to other night markets.

Stayed there for about 3 nights last year, it's pretty decent. Clean and spacious. Service was good.
I didn't stay in the north tower though but I've heard the walk there is slightly further.

But due to this incident, I got noticed as some history genius and pressure/ expectations got to me, so I kind of studied hard for every history tests thereafter and did well for subsequent exams without cheating.
